decisions.reason: As a 2023 flagship extension of the firm’s core organic Demeter dairy range, it carries high sunk investment, strong public commitment and strategic importance, so management would be very reluctant to withdraw it within the next year.

This 2024 sliced cheese launch fits closely with the established dairy business and likely uses existing capabilities, so despite lower visibility than a flagship product the firm would usually continue it unless early market feedback were clearly poor.

Because the 2024 sliced butter cheese is also near the firm’s core offer and benefits from existing cheesemaking assets, management would tend to persist with it for another year, though its more limited strategic prominence makes withdrawal somewhat easier than for Product A.
